phases.name: Connect
phases.rule: Every site up to the last one that bridges a piece (3 or more live repeaters) into the main mesh.

groups.gate: Gate: ≥2 logged neighbors on okimesh for 7 days.

phases.name: Reach
phases.rule: Next sites while each adds at least 25,000 people within 3 km (up to 8).

phases.name: Densify

risks.title: One failure still cuts a piece off

exposure.unit: live repeaters stranded by the worst single failure

risks.what: After Connect + Reach, the single failures that strand the most live repeaters from the main mesh: 🎸HENDRIX REPEATER (02488bef), 2; OH.DEL.POLARIS West (f26ae5f8), 2; SnagNet Base (2451a306), 1.
risks.mitigation: Run the Planner with the Redundancy objective to find a second path around 🎸HENDRIX REPEATER.
risks.source: regionalPlan.runs.likely links + linksObserved + linksInferred; each node removed in turn

risks.title: Most link odds are canopy estimates
risks.what: Unverified odds come from ESA WorldCover canopy near each end, not the trees on the path. Verified ones use lidar flown 2018–2021, 5–8 growing seasons ago.
risks.mitigation: Use the link-profile view for every new site proposal; reject paths that cross more than ~1 km of canopy at mount height.

risks.title: Observers can’t see part of the mesh

exposure.unit: live repeaters with no logged neighbors

risks.what: 5 of 14 observer stations have a position set. Gates are judged on okimesh, so a link nobody observes can look like a failure.
risks.mitigation: Add an observer in Lewis Center/Powell and one near Plain City; ask observer owners to set positions.

risks.title: Some radios answer to more than one key
risks.what: Co-located keys were merged by position. OH.FRA.MEOWE3 is a name used by two different keys. A renamed or re-keyed repeater can read as quiet on the live network.
risks.mitigation: Adopt a naming convention (area-site-number) and require a position on every repeater.

sites.name: Trenton Twp park, Hartford Rd (Sunbury)
sites.address: Hartford Road, Sunbury, Trenton Township, Delaware County, Ohio, 43074, United States
sites.rationale: Sunbury village sits at 309 m on the ridge east of Big Walnut Creek, 31 m above the live network average. It anchors the Sunbury ring and gives a second path back to Westerville (BarnRepeaterV2, 10.4 km, Possible).
sites.verifyNote: OpenStreetMap labels this a Trenton Township park but it resolves to a Hartford Rd address. Fallbacks: Big Walnut HS (295 m) or BST&G Fire (296 m), ~1.5 km away.

sites.name: Northgate Church (Galena west)
sites.address: Northgate Church, Fourwinds Drive, Berkshire Township, Delaware County, Ohio, United States
sites.rationale: On the west side of Galena near Alum Creek. Hands off to P3 Berlin HS at the Strong tier (33 ft), turning Sunbury into a ring instead of a dead end.

sites.name: Vans Valley Church
sites.address: Vans Valley Church, SR 37, Vans Valley, Trenton Township, Delaware County, Ohio, 43074, United States
sites.rationale: Best hop from the Sunbury ridge back to Westerville: BarnRepeaterV2 at 10.5 km, Likely at 33 ft. Also ties toward SnagNet/GreenCook.

sites.name: Mount Pleasant Community Church
sites.address: Mount Pleasant Community Church, Condit Road, Porter Township, Delaware County, Ohio, United States
sites.rationale: Highest ground in the north ridge (341 m). Links are only Possible today, so build last in Phase 1; its value is future reach toward Ashley and Morrow County.

sites.name: New Bethel Church
sites.address: New Bethel Church, Bethel Road, Hartford Township, Licking County, Ohio, 43013, United States
sites.rationale: Highest proposed site in Phase 1 (345 m). Reaches SnagNet at 8 km over almost open farmland (15 m of canopy on the path), giving SnagNet/GreenCook a second way in besides HENDRIX.

sites.name: Olentangy Orange Middle School
sites.address: Orange Middle School, 2680, East Orange Road, Orange Township, Delaware County, Ohio, 43035, United States
sites.rationale: The best-connected site in the plan: 16 Likely-or-better and 27 total links into Polaris, Skynet, CHEESE and Barn V2. Turns the Polaris core into a launch point for the whole north side.

sites.name: Peachblow Crossing Elementary
sites.address: Peachblow Crossing Elementary School, Peachblow Road, Berlin Township, Delaware County, Ohio, 43035, United St
sites.role: Joins ORANGEPARK + GEF-Parkway; starts the Marion chain
sites.rationale: Reaches INNO-ORANGEPARK (4.1 km) and GEF-Parkway (3.1 km) at the Strong tier — both are live but have no neighbors logged. Also starts the Marion chain (D2, 15.2 km, Likely at 33 ft).

sites.name: Olentangy Berlin High School
sites.address: Olentangy Berlin High School, Berlin Station Road, West Berlin, Berlin Township, Delaware County, Ohio, 40335,
sites.rationale: Ties Galena (S2), GEF-Parkway and Delaware (D1) together. Strong to P2 and GEF-Parkway.

sites.name: Highbanks Metro Park
sites.address: Wetland Spur Trail (0.4 mi), Orange Township, Delaware County, Ohio, 43240, United States
sites.role: Core infill, feeds the Dublin hop
sites.rationale: Three Strong links into the core (SolarShed, INNO-CROSSWOODS, KB8SXI) and the launch point for the Dublin hop.

sites.name: Grace United Methodist (Delaware)
sites.address: Grace United Methodist Church, East Central Avenue, Delaware, Delaware County, Ohio, 43015, United States
sites.role: Delaware city relay; second path north
sites.rationale: Delaware city relay. Strong into D2 (6.4 km) and Likely from P3 — the second path north if P2→D2 fades.

sites.name: Buckeye Valley MS/HS campus
sites.address: Buckeye Valley Middle School, 638, Coover Road, Troy Township, Delaware County, Ohio, 43015, United States
sites.role: Delaware → Marion (single point of failure until D4)
sites.rationale: The key site for joining Marion/Waldo (17 repeaters). Lidar shows a direct 12.1 km path to Oscar's in Waldo (Likely) because the corridor has less canopy than terrain-only models assume. Until D4 or a Marion-side south node exists, it is a single point of failure for about 17 repeaters at either height; pole-top raises its odds, a second entry removes the risk.

sites.name: Marlboro Church (Troy Twp)
sites.address: Marlboro Church, Horseshoe Road, Troy Township, Delaware County, Ohio, 43003, United States
sites.rationale: Spare path between D2 and D4. Only worth building if D2 or D4 underperforms.

sites.name: Norton gap-filler (host TBD, US-23 corridor)
sites.address: 8749, Weiser Road, Norton, Marlboro Township, Delaware County, Ohio, 43356, United States
sites.role: Second entry into Marion (ends D2 risk)
sites.rationale: Terrain-picked point near Norton on the US-23 corridor with no public host in map data. Second entry into Marion via PSC_Base / Waldo. Not needed to connect, but it is what ends D2's single-point-of-failure status. Talk to the Waldo/Marion operators first; a south-facing node on their side can replace it.
sites.verifyNote: No public host found in map data. Look for a church, grange or township lot within ~1 km along US-23, or coordinate with the Waldo/Marion group.

sites.name: Emerald Fields park (Dublin)
sites.address: Adare Court, Dublin, Washington Township, Franklin County, Ohio, 43065, United States
sites.role: First hop west of the core
sites.rationale: First hop west of INNO-CROSSWOODS into Dublin (prominence +10 m). Likely links to W2, W3 and CROSSWOODS.

sites.name: Tartan Ridge Park (Dublin/Jerome)
sites.address: 9343, Tartan Ridge Boulevard, Dublin, Washington Township, Union County, Ohio, 43017, United States
sites.rationale: High ground of NW Dublin / Jerome (307 m). Strong to W3 and W4 at 33 ft; the hub of the western ring.

sites.name: Olentangy Liberty HS (Powell)
sites.address: Olentangy Liberty High School, 3584, Home Road, Powell, Liberty Township, Delaware County, Ohio, 43065, United
sites.rationale: Powell. Strong to GEF-Parkway and INNO-ORANGEPARK, closing a Dublin–Lewis Center loop.

sites.name: Jerome Township Hall
sites.address: Jerome Township Hall, Industrial Parkway, New California, Jerome Township, Union County, Ohio, 43064, United S
sites.rationale: Jerome Township high ground (308 m). The only modeled way to reach KB3KVQ/R at Plain City (7.1 km, Likely).

sites.name: Westwoods Park & Ride (Prairie Twp)
sites.address: Westwoods Park and Ride, Westwoods Boulevard, Westland, Columbus, Franklin County, Ohio, 43228, United States
sites.rationale: The only site that reaches ARC8 near West Jefferson (7.7 km, Possible). Its link back to downtown (BIT1, 12.8 km) is Strong at 33 ft.

sites.name: Johnstown-Monroe HS
sites.address: Johnstown-Monroe High School, South Main Street, Johnstown, Monroe Township, Licking County, Ohio, 43031, Unit
sites.rationale: Highest site in the set (353 m). Extends the mesh east past SnagNet toward Johnstown.

sites.name: Hilliard Darby High School
sites.address: Hilliard Darby High School, Hilliard, Norwich Township, Franklin County, OH
sites.rationale: Hilliard fill-in with a single link (W1, Likely at 33 ft). Lowest-value site in the plan.
